svg.title: Always-on and conditionally applied instructions
svg.desc: An illustrative VS Code Python edit includes project-wide policy and a matching Python instruction. A documentation request still includes project-wide policy but does not newly apply that Python rule. Retained history may still contain earlier material.

text.tspan: MODEL CALL A / Edit a Python file
